notes: No source found reporting HUD-funded senior or disabled housing nonprofits that kept receiving HUD money or filing single audits after IRS automatic revocation, either for these groups or as a general pattern. Results were only explainers: HUD rules that Section 202/811 sponsors must hold IRS 501(c)(3) exemption, IRS automatic-revocation rules, single-audit rules. A 2013 TIGTA report on 25 exempt organizations that got $148M in government payments while not paying payroll taxes surfaced in snippets; it is a different scheme (those groups were still exempt), so it was not recorded. The lead names no individual nonprofit, so no entity-name search was possible.
